client.name: Example Co
client.offer: Missed-call text-back and online booking for local service businesses
client.one_line_pitch: We make sure every call and booking request gets an instant reply, even after hours.

signals.label: Calls go unanswered
signals.description: Customers say they could not reach the business, got voicemail, or never got a callback.

signals.label: Slow replies or scheduling
signals.description: Customers mention slow replies, long waits for an appointment, or hard-to-book schedules.

signals.label: Emergency or after-hours demand
signals.description: Customers needed help at night, weekends or in an emergency (shows after-hours volume).

signals.label: Busy or growing
signals.description: Reviews mention the team being busy, a new location, new trucks, or rapid growth.

signals.label: Great service but stretched
signals.description: Positive reviews that also mention being hard to reach or hard to schedule because they are in demand.
keywords: hard to get on the schedule

signals.label: Closing or sold
signals.description: Reviews mention the business closed, was sold, or changed ownership recently.
